# Qreek Finance

> Qreek Finance is a Nigerian fintech company for group and business payments. It offers payment pools for ajo savings groups, payment links for merchants, and payroll for businesses. Built on Flutterwave. Qreek never holds user funds.

- [Home](https://qreekfinance.org/): Product overview
- [FAQ](https://qreekfinance.org/faq): Common questions about how Qreek works
- [Register](https://qreekfinance.org/register): Create a Qreek account
